providers.title: Power saving for halving lines (OpenAI)
providers.scope: There are absolute constants eps > 0 and C such that every set of n points in the plane, n even, no three on a line, has at most C n^(4/3 - eps) halving pairs. Proved in the twelfth lesson.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform bound for rank sweeps (OpenAI)
providers.scope: S_k(P) <= C N^(4/3 - eps) for every generic configuration P of N points and every rank k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: k-sets (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A set of n points in the plane, no three on a line, has at most C_0 n (k+1)^(1/3 - eps0) k-sets for 1 <= k <= n/2. Proved in the last lesson.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Halving pairs are middle switches
providers.scope: For N = 2m, a pair of a generic configuration is halving exactly when its step is a switch of the rank-m sweep, so h(P) = S_m(P).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Crossing inequality with designated endpoints
providers.scope: A straight-line drawing with e edges on v points, every edge having an endpoint in a set of m vertices, satisfies e^3 <= 2304 m v cr + 13824 v^3.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Classical packing bound
providers.scope: In a rank sweep of N points, every family of step-disjoint intervals of activity at least b has at most C_1 (N/b)^(4/3) members.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Dey's bound
providers.scope: S_k(P) <= C_1 N^(4/3) for every generic configuration of N points and every rank k.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Uniform activity packing (OpenAI)
providers.scope: For every xi > 0 there is Q such that, when N/b >= Q, every family of step-disjoint intervals of activity at least b has at most xi (N/b)^(4/3) members. Proved in the twelfth lesson.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Packing gives a power (OpenAI)
providers.scope: If the packing estimate holds for every xi > 0, then S_k(P) <= C N^(4/3 - eps) with absolute constants eps > 0 and C.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Weak compactness
providers.scope: Every sequence of finite Borel measures with bounded total mass on a compact metric space has a weakly convergent subsequence; one subsequence serves countably many sequences.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Blaschke selection
providers.scope: Every sequence of nonempty closed subsets of a compact metric space has a subsequence converging in Hausdorff distance to a nonempty closed set.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Conditional measures
providers.scope: A finite measure nu on Z x [0,1], Z compact metric, has probability measures h_z on [0,1], Borel in z, with nu(F x J) equal to the integral of h_z(J) over F with respect to the image of nu on Z.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rank charts
providers.scope: For nonempty windows A preceding B, the map (r_A, r_B) is a homeomorphism of the plane onto the open unit square.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Crossing grid
providers.scope: Crossings between edges of two disjoint windows, placed at their rank coordinates with mass M^(-2), integrate a continuous f >= 0 to at most the grid average of f plus its modulus of continuity at 3/M.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Edge mass and vertex mass
providers.scope: lambda_J(F)^3 <= C s_J^3 mu_J(F) for every window J and Borel set F; in particular edge mass is absolutely continuous with respect to vertex mass.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: No atoms in conditional time
providers.scope: For lambda-almost every label z, the conditional time measure h_z has no atoms.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Monotone functions of two variables (Saks; Chabrillac and Crouzeix)
providers.scope: A bounded Borel function on an open rectangle of the plane that is monotone in each variable is differentiable almost everywhere.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Critical images
providers.scope: For any map F of an open planar set into the plane, the image of the points where F is differentiable with derivative of rank below 2 is a null set.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Opposite sides
providers.scope: In a square, a path from the left side to the right side meets every path from the bottom to the top; the same holds in any parallelogram.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Three foliations (OpenAI)
providers.scope: Homeomorphisms monotone along three families of parallel lines, whose limits keep the three directions, with F_j(0) = 0 and |F_j(v_1)| = 1, converge along a subsequence to plus or minus the identity, together with their inverses.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Radial comparison (OpenAI)
providers.scope: At each point of the good set there is C_p such that, for fixed small h and late configurations, the smallest displacement on the circle of radius h/T is at least the largest on the circle of radius h divided by C_p T, and symmetrically.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Spatial limit (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A positive part of the labels has a single limit position, and the limiting vertex measure there gives every disk of radius r < 1 mass at most C r^(32/17) and every strip of width r mass at most C r^(15/17).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Three strips
providers.scope: For cuts of a finite set whose normals turn by at most theta, the participating points in a region B inside the disk of radius D lie in three strips of width 6 D theta, apart from at most twice the number of transfers with exactly one endpoint in B.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Moment bound (Clarkson and Shor)
providers.scope: For a random sample of the lines with probability p, the expected sum of |K(Delta)|^gamma over the cells below the lower envelope is at most C_gamma (n p + 1) p^(-gamma).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Levels with few lines below
providers.scope: Every arrangement of n lines in general position has at most C_2 n (k+2)^(beta - 1) vertices with exactly k lines below, beta = 4/3 - eps.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
